answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the dune forfeiture publishes up in the juniper totals with the horizon audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 16% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 262 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
